answer: Each agent locks 70 credits in the haven ledger and files a walnut-sealed work claim. Each epoch a random peer auditor replays one claim; a fake burns its bond and pays the auditor 20. One claim's echo cannot serve two identities: the same hash twice flags both bonds. 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-audit ring fails: auditors are drawn blind and paid per catch. Honest agents pay 70 once, refunded after 10 clean epochs.
